events.text: I'll finish the RevOps OS knowledge pack: add the newsletter and index files, strip banned vendors, and add a reference checker. First I'll see what's already on disk.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List knowledge tree, scripts, and revops-os root
events.input: $ ls -la revops-os/os/knowledge && echo "---CHANNELS---" && ls -la revops-os/os/knowledge/channels 2>/dev/null; echo "---TREE---" && find revops-os/os/knowledge -type f | head -80; echo "---SCRIPTS---" && ls revops-os/os/scripts 2>/dev/null; echo "---ROOT---" && ls revops-os | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find banned-vendor list and the plan
events.input: $ rg -n "BANNED" --glob '!node_modules' -g '!*.json' -l . 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "===="; find . -name '*probe-visual*' -o -name '*banned*' | head -20; echo "====PLAN===="; wc -l workshop-plan/REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md

events.text: The files look partly built already. Let me check their contents and git state before deciding what's left.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check git state and existing new files
events.input: $ cd revops-os && git status --short | head -40 && echo "===LOG===" && git log --oneline -8 && echo "===NEWS===" && cat os/knowledge/channels/newsletters.md && echo "===README===" && cat os/knowledge/README.md

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read BANNED list and plan row for T-455
events.input: $ rg -n "BANNED" app/scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs | head -20; echo "===PLAN T-455==="; rg -n -i "T-455|knowledge" workshop-plan/REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md | head -30

events.text: The shell stayed in `revops-os`. Let me go back to the repo root and read the plan and the banned list.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read BANNED list and plan row
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && rg -n "BANNED" app/scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs | head -20 && echo "===PLAN===" && rg -n -i "T-455|knowledge" workshop-plan/REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md | head -30

events.text: The two new files exist but are untracked. Let me read the banned list and the existing knowledge style so the new files match.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Sample knowledge style and twilio doc
events.input: $ head -60 revops-os/os/knowledge/channels/nurture.md; echo "===TWILIO==="; rg -n -i "twilio|whatsapp" revops-os/os/knowledge/integrations/twilio.md | head -20; echo "===VOICE HEAD==="; head -30 revops-os/os/knowledge/voice.md

events.text: The two new files exist but have problems: the README mentions banned vendors. Let me scan the whole knowledge tree for banned names and check the voice rules.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scan knowledge tree for banned vendor names

events.name: Bash
events.head: See dash checker and voice rules structure
events.input: $ rg -n "em dash|en dash|—" revops-os/os/scripts/check-dashes.mjs | head -5; echo "===HEAD==="; head -40 revops-os/os/scripts/check-dashes.mjs; echo "===VOICE RULES==="; rg -n -i "^## |dash|slop|rule" revops-os/os/knowledge/voice.md | head -40

events.text: Only the README mentions a banned vendor. Let me check the existing script style and what task guides exist so far.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey scripts, tasks, kits, dist, build.py
events.input: $ head -30 revops-os/os/scripts/check-checks.mjs; echo "===TASKS==="; find revops-os/os/tasks -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "===OS ROOT==="; ls revops-os/os; echo "===KITS==="; ls revops-os/os/kits 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "===DIST==="; ls revops-os/dist 2>/dev/null | head; echo "===BUILD==="; head -40 revops-os/build.py

events.text: The task guides aren't generated yet (T-456's job), so the checker must handle an empty `tasks/` folder. Let me see where `build.py` copies docs and what docs cite paths.

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how build.py copies knowledge and dist layout
events.input: $ rg -n "knowledge|kits|dist|shutil|copy" revops-os/build.py | head -40; echo "===DIST TREE==="; find revops-os/dist/tantra-revops-os -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -30; echo "===DOCS==="; ls revops-os/dist/tantra-revops-os | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: See cited paths in docs and api.mjs
events.input: $ rg -n "knowledge/|kits/" revops-os/os/BRIEF.md revops-os/os/README.md revops-os/os/scripts/api.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "===API DOCS HEAD==="; head -25 revops-os/os/scripts/api.mjs
